svg.title: A radial triangulation lift
svg.desc: Two exact radial graphs over the base (u,1), minus one to one. Straight model heights R1=1/(3-abs(u)) and R2=10/(15-3abs(u)) lift to analytic heights r1=1/3+u squared/6 and r2=2/3+u squared/6. Barycentric subdivision adds the base vertex u=0. Blue bands are between the graphs; purple points are the exact middle of the model interval on the ray u=1/2 and its image.
